entities.name: COLLECT (KINESIS DATA STREAMS)
entities.rationale: Primary Amazon Kinesis Data Stream collecting real-time event streams.

entities.name: RULES (KINESIS DATA STREAMS)
entities.rationale: Secondary Amazon Kinesis Data Stream evaluating rules on streamed telemetry data.

entities.name: NEPTUNE
entities.rationale: Amazon Neptune graph database storing relationship and graph network data.

entities.name: ELASTICSEARCH
entities.rationale: Amazon OpenSearch/Elasticsearch service providing search and indexing capabilities.

entities.name: CLOUDWATCH
entities.rationale: Amazon CloudWatch monitoring system performance, logs, and metrics.

entities.name: DYNAMODB
entities.rationale: Amazon DynamoDB table storing key-value operational state and alert metadata.

entities.name: NOTIFICATIONS (SLACK / EMAIL)
entities.rationale: External notification channels (Slack/Email) receiving operational alerts.

visual_connections.description: Streamed events are passed from the collection layer to the rules processing stream.
Ingests high-volume graph entities (50M+) directly into Amazon Neptune.
Rules processing stream queries and updates relationships in Amazon Neptune.
Evaluated rule outputs and state updates are stored in DynamoDB.
Neptune synchronizes graph entities into Elasticsearch for full-text indexing.
Neptune pushes cluster metrics and audit logs to Amazon CloudWatch.
Neptune exports metadata or syncs state directly into DynamoDB.
Triggers alert messages and notifications sent to Slack and Email channels.
